card.name: Inside capitalized boxed-warning words
card.fires_on: Partway through all-caps words in boxed warning headings, mainly the UM in T-UM-ORS in 'THYROID C-CELL TUMORS'. Also fires on linking words in all-caps warning titles.

modes.label: Tumors in thyroid warning
modes.description: The UM piece inside TUMORS in the all-caps thyroid C-cell tumor boxed warning.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK OF THYROID C-CELL T<<UM>>ORS • Liraglutide causes

modes.label: Other all-caps warning words
modes.description: Pieces of other long capitalized words or linking words in boxed warning titles.
modes.example: HEMATOLOGIC TOXICITY, and VENOUS<< and>> ARTERIAL THROMBOEMB

card.writes: It pushes toward all-caps word beginnings ending in R, like AR, BR, DR, TR, and away from other capital-letter starts.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a capitalized word in a boxed warning headline, especially thyroid tumor warnings.
